data.comment:
# Comfy Sonilo- Text to Music Generation

Generate high-quality, production-ready music from text prompts. Input descriptive text to create original soundtracks with streaming playback and precise duration control. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_sonilo_t2m.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Ethereal light music, soft atmosphere, clean and healing
